description: Destructively consume and return ciphertext using the read token. Decrypt locally; never send the key to MCP. Consumption happens before the response: a lost response cannot be recovered by retrying. Reveal only with explicit intent; never automatically retry. No API key, no account and no sign up: call it directly.

read_token.description: The read_token returned once at creation. Authorizes one destructive ciphertext reveal.

secret_id.description: The secret_id returned at creation; not a credential.

name: reveal_one_time_secret
title: Consume one encrypted secret
